placeholder.title: Evaluations
placeholder.description: Dataset versions and experiment results for this Bot will be listed here once the observability store is connected. Nothing is missing from the Bot itself.

page.title: Evaluations
page.description: Frozen dataset versions and experiment results for this Bot.

disabled.title: Evaluation is off
disabled.description: Observability is disabled for this deployment, so experiments cannot run.

empty.title: No experiments yet
empty.description: Pick a frozen dataset version and a Bot configuration to submit the first experiment.

forbidden.title: You cannot run this experiment
forbidden.description: Experiments follow the Bot's management rights and are re-checked before every sample.

notFound.title: No such experiment
notFound.description: This address names an experiment or execution your scope does not hold — either it never existed or it belongs to someone else.

unscored.title: Score unavailable for this sample
unscored.description: The sample produced no score. A missing score is not a zero, and it is excluded from the average rather than counted as a failure.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: This field could not be handled safely, so only metrics are shown. Omitted is not the same as empty.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: This value exceeds the recorded size limit and was cut.

syncing.title: Results still syncing
syncing.description: The experiment finished but its scores are not confirmed upstream yet. Syncing is not success.

unavailable.title: Upstream unavailable
unavailable.description: The observability store did not answer. Runs already in flight kept their hold; nothing was released or double-charged.

submit.rowDescription: Freeze a Bot configuration against a frozen dataset version and submit it for evaluation.
submit.dialogDescription: The configuration freezes as submitted — the dataset version, prompt, model, parameters, tool fixtures and judge are pinned, and resubmitting the same configuration hits the same experiment.
submit.name: Experiment name
submit.incomplete: A name, a frozen version, a prompt, a model and a judge version are needed before submitting.
submit.jsonInvalid: This field must be a JSON object.
submit.versionsUnavailable: The frozen versions of this dataset did not answer.
submit.submittedReplay: This configuration was already frozen — the existing experiment answered, and nothing new was created.

results.executionDescription: The safe execution record this report links back to — the run that produced these samples.
results.summaryDescription: Every class is counted on its own; the mean averages scored samples only.
results.samplesDescription: One row per frozen case, with its class, score, reason and usage.
results.meanNone: No sample was scored — a missing score is not a zero.

error.EXPERIMENT_INPUT_INVALID: The experiment name or configuration is not valid. Nothing was submitted.
error.EXPERIMENT_DATASET_VERSION_NOT_FOUND: This Bot's datasets hold no frozen version with that id. Nothing was submitted.
error.EXPERIMENT_STATE_INVALID: The experiment's state refuses this. Nothing changed.
error.EXECUTION_STATE_INVALID: Only a running execution can be canceled — this one has already settled.
error.unreachable: The observability store did not answer. Nothing changed.

comparison.selectDescription: A comparison spans two experiments, so it cannot live under either one: name a baseline and a candidate — one experiment id and one execution id each. Both sides are read as your scope sees them.
comparison.incomplete: All four ids are needed before a comparison can be read.
comparison.sidesDescription: Each side's own facts: state, scored samples, completion, usage, and the server-minted result link back to the safe execution record.
comparison.compatibilityDescription: The frozen sample set and the scoring definition must match; every other difference is the configuration being compared — shown, never hidden, never blocking.
comparison.compatible: Comparable — the same frozen sample set under the same scoring definition.
comparison.incompatible: Not comparable — the blocking fields differ, so no winner is claimed and no deltas are shown.
comparison.configDifference: A configuration difference — shown, never blocking
comparison.deltasDescription: One row per shared frozen case; the mean delta is the difference of the two means. A sample still in flight or awaiting reconciliation stays not comparable — its verdict is still open.
comparison.meanDeltaNone: No mean delta — a missing mean is not a zero.
comparison.scoreDeltaNone: No score delta — a missing score is not a zero.
comparison.regressionsDescription: The samples that got worse — each row names the frozen case and links both execution records.
